faq.a: Bluefin tuna season in Estepona runs from June to October, with peak activity in August. Water temperatures reach 24°C, drawing large schools within 5–10 nautical miles of the coast. Early morning charters (7–11 AM) often see the best action.

data.body_html:
Estepona fishing charter tuna season 2032 is shaping up to be a record year for bluefin tuna in the Costa del Sol. From June to October, the warm currents off Estepona draw massive schools of Atlantic bluefin, making it one of Europe's top sportfishing destinations. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes east of Estepona, and every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Whether you're after a half-day trip or a full-day expedition, we've got the boat and the local knowledge to put you on the fish.

Why Estepona for Tuna Fishing in 2032

Estepona's coastline sits at the edge of the Alboran Sea, a migration corridor for bluefin tuna heading to the Mediterranean spawning grounds. In 2032, water temperatures are expected to remain above 22°C from June through October, extending the feeding season. The seabed drops steeply just 3 nautical miles offshore, creating ideal conditions for trolling and live-bait fishing. Local skippers report consistent catches of bluefin between 30kg and 150kg, with the occasional monster over 200kg. For a reliable estepona fishing charter tuna season 2032, book early—August slots fill by May.

Best Boats for Tuna Fishing from Puerto Banús

Our fleet includes vessels suited for both serious anglers and family groups. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a spacious cockpit, fighting chair, and a free jet ski for exploring between drifts. For smaller groups, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) combines speed with stability, reaching the tuna grounds in under 20 minutes. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) provides a shaded flybridge and ample rod storage. All boats come with a licensed skipper who knows the local hotspots like Cala del Faro and the Estepona Canyon.

Pricing and Inclusions for Your Charter

Our Tier A boats—Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39—start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, with a jet ski included free. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Fishing gear is provided at no extra cost—just let us know your preferred tackle.

Best Times and Techniques for Bluefin Tuna

Bluefin tuna are most active during the early morning hours, 6–10 AM, when they feed near the surface. Trolling with large lures or live bait (mackerel, sardines) is the standard technique. From August onward, chunking and chumming can be effective as the fish become more scattered. Your skipper will adjust based on sea conditions and recent catch reports. Afternoon charters can also be productive, especially during the August peak when water temperatures hit 24°C. For the best experience, book a full-day charter (8 hours) to cover multiple grounds.

What to Expect on the Day

Your charter begins at Puerto Banús, where you'll meet your skipper for a safety briefing and gear setup. Head out past the Marbella coastline, with views of La Concha mountain, and reach the fishing grounds within 15–20 minutes. The skipper will set the lines and monitor the fish finder. Once hooked, expect a fight lasting 30 minutes to 2 hours. The crew will assist with landing, tagging, and releasing or cleaning your catch. Lunch is served on board—typically fresh local seafood, paella, or grilled meats, depending on the package.

Local Regulations and Conservation

Andalusia strictly regulates bluefin tuna fishing. Only fish over 30kg may be retained, and catch-and-release is strongly encouraged. Our skippers hold all necessary permits and will advise on daily limits. We support sustainable fishing practices and recommend using circle hooks to reduce injury. For the latest on estepona fishing charter tuna season 2032 regulations, check with your skipper on booking day.

How to Book Your Estepona Fishing Charter

Booking is simple. Choose your boat from our fleet page and contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance for June and July, and four weeks for August. Deposits are 50% of the total, with the balance due on the day. Cancellations up to 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. For groups of 8–12, the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 are ideal. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 or Pershing 46 offer excellent value.
